source_text: Religious justifications, often invoked in Muslim-majority practicing communities, lack direct Quranic support—FGM is absent from the text and stems from pre-Islamic tribal customs—while major Islamic authorities, including Egypt's Al-Azhar University, have issued fatwas deeming it un-Islamic and harmful. [34]
